apps.name: SKapsule
apps.subtitle: Spiral Knights for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
Play Spiral Knights on iPhone and iPad. SKapsule runs the real desktop client on your device: a bundled Java 25 runtime, the game's OpenGL renderer translated to OpenGL ES, OpenAL audio, touch and controller support, and Web or Steam login.

Experimental. JIT is required: enable it with the built-in helper (pairing file + LocalDevVPN) or the StikDebug app. The game (about 440 MB) downloads from the official servers on first launch. Unofficial, not affiliated with Grey Havens or Three Rings.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes the game freezing when opening the friends list with Steam sign-in.

Adds a server picker for custom servers, a JIT Setup bottom sheet with pairing on the device itself (iOS 27+), pairing files, StikDebug, TrollStore and jailbreak ways, LocalDevVPN connect, a clearer JIT-not-enabled message, and an Automatic JIT method. Asks for Local Network access.

Mods can no longer replace the behavior, spawn table and variant table configs. A first launch that downloads the game is no longer called a failed start. Apply Mods before the first launch asks for a launch first, and cancelling the JIT wait is no longer reported as a failure.

Adds Check for Updates. Hardens mod archive parsing, the news feed and log scrubbing. Fixes Download Modpack deleting your own mods, half-applied mods, the game being killed when you leave the app, stalled downloads, Steam login and Steam Guard issues, a built-in JIT hang, and mouse button tracking.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: SKapsule finds this device's debug service and pairs with itself to enable JIT, and connects to private game servers on your network.
